title: Police search for suspects after shooting at Brown University in Rhode Island – latest updates
summary: Suspect or suspects at large as Ivy League university tells students to take shelter during second day of final exams Multiple people shot at Brown University in Rhode Island, police say At least two people have been killed and several others injured in the shooting, a law enforcement source told the Associated Press.
